newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May chain store sales down 4.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan May chain store sales down 4.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at chain stores in Japan in May declined 4.6 percent from a year earlier to 1.34 trillion yen, the Japan Chain Stores Association said on Tuesday.
Month on month, chain store sales rose 1.4 percent in May, the association said in a statement.

Sales were generally favourable at the beginning of the month, but foul weather -- low temperatures and rain -- hurt sales of products designed for summer during the latter half of May, the association said.

Sales growth in large and expensive items such as furniture and household electrical appliances, which saw high demand before the rise in the national consumption tax in April, remained sluggish, it added.
Japan's consumption tax was raised to five percent from three percent on April 1.
The study covered 7,829 outlets of 130 chain store operators.
